summary: Sedana Medical AB (publ), a medtech and pharmaceutical company, develops, manufactures, and sells medical devices and pharmaceutical products in Sweden, Spain, Germany, and internationally. The company offers Sedaconda ACD-L and Sedaconda ACD-S, which are disposable medical devices that enable the administration of volatile anaesthetics; Sedaconda Syringe, a syringe with a connection to fit the connector on the agent line of the Sedaconda ACD and Sedana Medical filling adapters; Sedaconda ACD starter kit; Sedaconda (Isoflurane) for maintenance of sedation in intubated or tracheostomised mechanically ventilated adult and paediatric patients from 3 years of age; Sedaconda Filling Adapter, a single-use medical device; FlurAbsorb Pro-L and Pro-S; FlurAbsorb and Mounts; Scavenging Tube, a one piece pre-connected tube, that is designed to channel anaesthetic waste gas from the ventilator exhaust port and the gas monitor exhaust port to the FlurAbsorb filter; and Mindray exhaust connector enables to connect the exhaust of the ventilator to an active or passive scavenging system. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Danderyd, Sweden.
